touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Spilsby qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST JAMES and Spilsby market cross. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Spilsby: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Spilsby offers CHURCH OF ST JAMES, Spilsby market cross, FORMER MARKET HALL within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST JAMES
